path.title: Backend Development
path.description: Build robust server-side applications, APIs, and databases. Learn to handle authentication, security, and scalability.

nodes.title: Internet & Networking
nodes.description: Understanding TCP/IP, HTTP protocols, DNS, and how clients communicate with servers.

nodes.title: OS Basics
nodes.description: Operating system fundamentals: processes, threads, memory management, and file systems.

nodes.title: Programming Language
nodes.description: Choose and master a backend language: Python, Node.js, Java, Go, or Ruby.
nodes.topic_keywords: python, nodejs, java, golang, ruby, backend-language

nodes.title: Version Control
nodes.description: Git workflows, branching strategies, and collaborative development practices.

nodes.title: Relational Databases
nodes.description: SQL fundamentals, database design, normalization, and querying with PostgreSQL or MySQL.
nodes.topic_keywords: sql, postgres, mysql, database, rdbms, normalization

nodes.title: NoSQL Databases
nodes.description: Document stores, key-value databases, and when to use MongoDB or Redis.

nodes.title: APIs & REST
nodes.description: Designing and building RESTful APIs: endpoints, HTTP methods, status codes, and best practices.
nodes.topic_keywords: api, rest, endpoints, http, json, crud

nodes.title: Authentication
nodes.description: Secure your APIs: JWT, OAuth2, session-based auth, and password hashing.
nodes.topic_keywords: auth, jwt, oauth, security, authentication, authorization
